version_note: v67: promoted frozen strict-R3 rich SimplePolicyOptimiser challenger. It applies the selected separate TP/SL median-anchored ATR transforms, absolute floors/caps, activation decay, fixed giveback, capital protection and frozen fast-adverse threshold. Existing positions are deliberately migrated from their actual fills; new rich exits are owned by the one-minute controller, not predecessor shadow exits.
execution_adjusted_ev: raw_expected_gross_bps - adverse_delay_gap_bps - max(80 bps, 1.2 * live_full_spread_bps + 2 * entry_impact_bps); raw_expected_gross_bps is the explicit MC1 gross convention and the historical 100-bps policy cost is not debited again; must remain at least +50 bps at preflight and after fill
position_monitor: persistent one-minute rich-policy controller. Protective stop, trailing and timeout consume only post-fill closed 1m bars; rich policy distances use its frozen 15m-calibrated median anchor; Adaptive Exit V1 is retained only as a relative activation modulator; predecessor hourly shadow exits are prohibited for rich positions.
close_reporting: v67: close reports retain policy threshold, actual protective/market fill and rich policy lineage; fee-pending reports show confirmed gross PnL without claiming confirmed net PnL.
